scripts.env:init: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); if(!fs.existsSync('.env')&&fs.existsSync('.env.example')){fs.copyFileSync('.env.example','.env');console.log('Created .env from .env.example — isi SUPABASE_* dan admin.');}else if(fs.existsSync('.env')){console.log('.env sudah ada.');}else{console.log('Salin .env.example ke .env manual.');}"
